description: Source code implementing flash I/O operations for Bluetooth Mesh Blob storage in Zephyr OS, including functions for opening, closing, reading, writing, and erasing flash memory blocks.

methods.name: test_flash_area
methods.description: Checks if the flash area with given ID is properly aligned and accessible.

methods.name: io_open
methods.description: Opens the flash IO for a given transfer mode.

methods.name: io_close
methods.description: Closes the flash IO for a given transfer.

methods.name: block_start
methods.description: Prepares a flash block for reading or writing, erasing if necessary.

methods.name: rd_chunk
methods.description: Reads a chunk of data from flash memory.

methods.name: wr_chunk
methods.description: Writes a chunk of data to flash memory, ensuring proper block alignment.

methods.name: bt_mesh_blob_io_flash_init
methods.description: Initializes the flash IO structure with specified area ID and offset.
